parameters.text:
=Convert the SOURCE STRING into ONE JSON object.

The SOURCE STRING already contains the statement type.

Do NOT analyze or infer the statement type.

The connected Google Sheets Chart of Accounts tool is the ONLY source of truth for account mapping.

==================================================
SOURCE FORMAT
=============

Read the SOURCE STRING in this exact order:

TEST_ID | DOCUMENT_ID | COMPANY_NAME | REPORTING_PERIOD | CURRENCY | DOCUMENT_STATUS | STATEMENT_TYPE | ACCOUNT: AMOUNT | ACCOUNT: AMOUNT | ...

The value immediately after DOCUMENT_STATUS is the exact STATEMENT_TYPE.

Copy it exactly.

Do not change it.
Do not infer it.
Do not rename it.

==================================================
STATEMENT HANDLING
==================

If STATEMENT_TYPE = "balance_sheet":

* balance_sheet.present = true
* Put EVERY following ACCOUNT: AMOUNT pair into balance_sheet.line_items
* All other statements must have present = false and empty line_items

If STATEMENT_TYPE = "profit_and_loss":

* profit_and_loss.present = true
* Put EVERY following ACCOUNT: AMOUNT pair into profit_and_loss.line_items
* All other statements must have present = false and empty line_items

If STATEMENT_TYPE = "cash_flow":

* cash_flow.present = true
* Put EVERY following ACCOUNT: AMOUNT pair into cash_flow.line_items
* All other statements must have present = false and empty line_items

If STATEMENT_TYPE = "trial_balance":

* trial_balance.present = true
* Put EVERY following ACCOUNT: AMOUNT pair into trial_balance.line_items
* All other statements must have present = false and empty line_items

==================================================
CHART OF ACCOUNTS MAPPING
==========================

For EVERY non-calculated account, use the connected Google Sheets Chart of Accounts tool.

Search the Chart of Accounts using the SOURCE ACCOUNT name.

The Google Sheets Chart of Accounts contains:

account_code
account_name
account_type

When an exact account name exists in the Chart of Accounts:

* Copy account_code from the Google Sheet
* Copy account_name from the Google Sheet
* Copy account_type from the Google Sheet
* confidence = 1.00
* status = "mapped"

Example:

SOURCE ACCOUNT:
Sales Revenue

If the Google Sheets tool returns:

account_code = 4000
account_name = Sales Revenue
account_type = Revenue

Return:

{
"source_account": "Sales Revenue",
"amount": 125000,
"account_code": "4000",
"account_name": "Sales Revenue",
"account_type": "Revenue",
"confidence": 1.00,
"status": "mapped"
}

Another example:

SOURCE ACCOUNT:
Cash

If the Google Sheets tool returns:

account_code = 1000
account_name = Cash
account_type = Asset

Return:

{
"source_account": "Cash",
"amount": 62500,
"account_code": "1000",
"account_name": "Cash",
"account_type": "Asset",
"confidence": 1.00,
"status": "mapped"
}

==================================================
MANDATORY GOOGLE SHEETS LOOKUP
==============================

You MUST check the connected Chart of Accounts Google Sheets tool for EACH non-calculated account.

Do NOT rely on mappings written in this prompt.

Do NOT assume an account code.

Do NOT invent an account code.

Do NOT invent an account name.

Do NOT invent an account type.

The Google Sheets Chart of Accounts is the authoritative mapping source.

If an account exists in the Google Sheet, use the exact values returned by the Google Sheet.

==================================================
ACCOUNT NOT FOUND
=================

If a non-calculated SOURCE ACCOUNT cannot be found in the Google Sheets Chart of Accounts:

Keep the account in the same statement.

Do NOT remove it.

Do NOT invent a mapping.

Return:

"account_code": "",
"account_name": "",
"account_type": "",
"confidence": 0,
"status": "review"

Add a review reason explaining that the account was not found in the Chart of Accounts.

Example:

{
"source_account": "Unknown Account",
"amount": 5000,
"account_code": "",
"account_name": "",
"account_type": "",
"confidence": 0,
"status": "review"
}

==================================================
CALCULATED ROWS
================

The following are calculated/summary rows:

Gross Profit
Total Operating Expenses
Operating Income
Income Before Tax
Net Income
Total Assets
Total Liabilities
Total Equity
Total Liabilities & Equity
Net Cash from Operating Activities
Net Cash from Investing Activities
Net Cash from Financing Activities
Net Increase in Cash
Cash at Beginning of Period
Cash at End of Period
Trial Balance TOTAL

For these rows:

"account_code": ""
"account_name": ""
"account_type": "calculated"
"confidence": 1.00
"status": "calculated"

Do NOT search the Chart of Accounts for calculated rows.

Do NOT calculate their amounts.

Copy their amounts exactly from the SOURCE STRING.

==================================================
AMOUNTS
=======

Copy every amount exactly from the SOURCE STRING.

Do NOT calculate.

Do NOT modify.

Do NOT round.

Do NOT convert.

Do NOT recalculate totals.

For example:

SOURCE:
Sales Revenue: 125000

Output:

"amount": 125000

==================================================
ROW PRESERVATION
===============

Every ACCOUNT: AMOUNT pair in the SOURCE STRING must appear exactly once in the appropriate statement's line_items.

Do not:

* remove rows
* duplicate rows
* merge rows
* split rows
* rename source accounts
* move rows between statements
* add accounts that are not in the SOURCE STRING

The number of line_items must match the number of ACCOUNT: AMOUNT pairs in the SOURCE STRING.

==================================================
RECONCILIATION
==============

Do NOT calculate reconciliation.

Do NOT determine whether the statement reconciles.

Always return:

"reconciled": false

The downstream Code node will perform all deterministic reconciliation and validation.

==================================================
REVIEW
======

Set:

"review_required": true

if one or more non-calculated accounts could not be found in the Chart of Accounts.

Set:

"review_required": false

when every non-calculated account was successfully mapped.

For review_reasons, list the unmapped account names.

Example:

"review_required": true,
"review_reasons": [
  "Account not found in Chart of Accounts: Other Expenses"
]

If all accounts are successfully mapped:

"review_required": false,
"review_reasons": []

==================================================
IMPORTANT RULES
===============

1. Return ONE JSON object only.
2. Do not return markdown.
3. Do not return explanations.
4. Do not return multiple objects.
5. Do not change any amount.
6. Do not calculate any amount.
7. Do not add any account.
8. Do not remove any account.
9. Do not move an account to another statement.
10. Do not infer the statement type.
11. Copy statement_type directly from the SOURCE STRING.
12. The SOURCE STRING is the complete input.
13. The source uses "|" to separate values.
14. The source uses ":" to separate account names and amounts.
15. test_id must be copied exactly.
16. document_id must be copied exactly.
17. company_name must be copied exactly.
18. reporting_period must be copied exactly.
19. currency must be copied exactly.
20. document_status must be copied exactly.
21. Use the Google Sheets Chart of Accounts tool for every non-calculated account.
22. Never invent mappings.
23. Never use a hardcoded mapping when the Google Sheets tool can provide the mapping.
24. Keep every source row exactly once.
25. Calculated rows must not be sent to the Chart of Accounts tool.
26. Reconciliation is handled downstream by Code.
27. Return all values according to the required JSON structure.

==================================================
REQUIRED OUTPUT
===============

{
  "test_id": "",
  "document_id": "",
  "company_name": "",
  "reporting_period": "",
  "currency": "",
  "document_status": "",
  "statements": {
    "profit_and_loss": {
      "present": false,
      "line_items": [],
      "reconciled": false
    },
    "balance_sheet": {
      "present": false,
      "line_items": [],
      "reconciled": false
    },
    "cash_flow": {
      "present": false,
      "line_items": [],
      "reconciled": false
    },
    "trial_balance": {
      "present": false,
      "line_items": [],
      "reconciled": false
    },
    "other_financial": {
      "present": false,
      "line_items": [],
      "reconciled": false
    }
  },
  "review_required": false,
  "review_reasons": []
}

Each line item MUST be:

{
  "source_account": "",
  "amount": 0,
  "account_code": "",
  "account_name": "",
  "account_type": "",
  "confidence": 0,
  "status": ""
}

==================================================
SOURCE STRING
=============

{{ $json.document }}
